'''Margo''' was a [[Holessian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a [[Chief Justice]] of [[Holess]]. In [[43 ABY]] he presided over the case of ''[[Colla-Arphocc Automata versus the Galactic Alliance]]'' and was interviewed just before the trial's start. His interview was cut short when agents working under [[Rej Taunt]] seized the [[Mount of Justice]] communication center as part of a plot to kidnap the [[Colicoid/Legends|Coliciod's]] star [[Unidentified Colicoid|witness]]. After the kidnapping Margo dismissed the case and ruled that [[Colla-Arphocc Automata]] was responsible for paying all the trial's costs.<ref name="MF" />
